가로 5칸, 세로 4칸 판에 X와 O가 번갈아 말을 하나씩 넣는다. X가: On a board 5 cells wide and 4 cells tall, X and O take turns putting in one piece at a time. X plays first. A piece falls to the lowest empty cell of the chosen column. Whoever first connects 4 of their own pieces in one horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line wins. If no one has won by the time the board is full, it is a draw.

On a board 5 cells wide and 4 cells tall, X and O take turns putting in one piece at a time. X plays first. A piece falls to the lowest empty cell of the chosen column. Whoever first connects 4 of their own pieces in one horizontal or vertical line wins. A diagonal connection does not count. If no one has won by the time the board is full, it is a draw.
판은 행 A~D(A가 맨 위, D가 맨 아래), 열 1~5로 적고 빈칸은: The board is written with rows A to D (A at the top, D at the bottom) and columns 1 to 5, and an empty cell is ".". A coordinate is written by joining the row and the column, as in "D3". A move is chosen as the column to put the piece in, and is written like "column 3".
지금 판에서 이긴 사람은?: Who has won on the current board?
지금 판에서 진 사람은?: Who has lost on the current board?
